'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Western Russia attacks]]
***A civilian is killed and two others are injured by Ukrainian [[shell (projectile)|shelling]] on [[Valuyki, Belgorod Oblast|Valuyki]], [[Belgorod Oblast]], according to Governor [[Vyacheslav Gladkov]]. [https://www.urdupoint.com/en/world/one-dead-two-injured-in-russias-belgorod-re-1563596.html (UrduPoint)] [https://www.msn.com/en-ca/news/world/russia-accuses-ukraine-of-attacking-russian-town-on-common-border/ar-AA11T3dt?li=AAggFp4 (MSN)]
*[[Internal conflict in Myanmar]]
**[[2021–2022 Myanmar insurgency]]
***[[Myanmar Army]] helicopters attack a school in [[Sagaing Region]], [[Myanmar]], killing six children and injuring 17 people. Military officials say that the school was being used as a base by anti-[[2021 Myanmar coup d'état|coup]] insurgents. [https://www.jpost.com/breaking-news/article-717527 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
*[[2022 Kyrgyzstan–Tajikistan clashes]]
**According to Kyrgyzstan, [[Armed Forces of the Republic of Tajikistan|Tajik forces]] again open fire on its outposts and clashes occur along the [[Kyrgyzstan–Tajikistan border|border]] with Tajik forces using [[armored vehicle]]s and [[mortar (weapon)|mortars]]. Tajikistan accuses [[Armed Forces of the Kyrgyz Republic|Kyrgyz forces]] of shelling one of its outposts and several villages. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/kyrgyzstan-says-border-outposts-under-tajik-fire-again-2022-09-16/ (Reuters)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/amp/news/2022/9/16/renewed-fighting-escalation-at-kyrgyzstan-tajikistan-border (Al Jazeera)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on the performing arts]]
**''[[The Phantom of the Opera (1986 musical)|The Phantom of the Opera]]'', currently the [[List of the longest-running Broadway shows|longest-running show]] in [[Broadway theatre|Broadway]] history, announces that it will end production in February 2023, stating that a decline in attendance caused by the [[COVID-19 pandemic]] has made it unable to recoup the weekly costs of running the show. [https://www.nytimes.com/2022/09/16/theater/phantom-of-the-opera-broadway-closing.html (''The New York Times'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*American [[computer hardware]] company [[EVGA Corporation|EVGA]] terminates its partnership with fellow hardware manufacturer [[Nvidia]] and withdraws completely from the [[graphics card]] market, alleging that the latter forced them to sell their cards at a loss and would refuse to disclose important information, such as sales numbers. [https://www.theverge.com/2022/9/16/23357031/evga-nvidia-graphics-cards-stops-making (''The Verge'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022–23 European windstorm season]]
**Ten people are killed, 50 others are injured, and three people are reported missing as floods hit [[Ancona]], [[Marche]], [[Italy]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/least-seven-dead-flash-floods-hit-italys-marche-region-italian-media-2022-09-16/ (Reuters)]
*[[2022 South Asian floods]]
**Twelve people are killed by heavy rains in [[Lucknow]], [[Uttar Pradesh]], [[India]], with nine of the people killed when a wall collapsed. [https://apnews.com/article/india-climate-and-environment-58e19a4f6a3322106141d3f81995e49d (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2022 monkeypox outbreak]]
**[[2022 monkeypox outbreak in Asia]]
***[[Bahrain]] confirms its first case of [[monkeypox]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/bahrain-detects-first-monkeypox-case-state-media-2022-09-16/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Killing of Mahsa Amini]]
**Widespread protests occur in [[Iran]] after a woman is detained and allegedly beaten to death in [[Tehran]] by officers from Iran's [[Guidance Patrol|religious police]] system for not properly wearing her [[hijab]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/sep/17/iran-protests-death-kurdish-woman-mahsaa-amini-morality-police (The Guardian)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 Salvadoran general election]]
**Incumbent [[President of El Salvador|President]] [[Nayib Bukele]] announces that he will run for re-election in 2024, one year after the [[Supreme Court of El Salvador|Supreme Court]] ruled that he was eligible to do so despite a [[Constitution of El Salvador|constitutional]] ban on presidential [[Elections in El Salvador|re-election]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/9/16/el-salvadors-bukele-says-he-will-seek-re-election-despite-ban (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/despite-prohibition-el-salvador-president-bukele-says-he-will-seek-re-election-2022-09-16/ (Reuters)]
